message: Preregistered a five-scale fixed-20k tokenizer experiment after CR-TOK-0002 exposed an optimizer-step confound. All scales and four milestone evaluations are unconditional; dynamics remains blocked.
Bound the fixed-20k runner, exact milestone checkpoint selection and fault-only resume policy to a durable source commit before remote launch.
Started exactly one fixed-20k pipeline on the existing A10 from the detached source commit; no CR-TOK-0002 checkpoint was reused.
Exact probe completed and fresh n0.17m training began at 0/20,000. The generated plan confirms all five arms receive 20,000 updates and dynamics remains blocked.
Fresh n0.17m completed exactly 20,000 optimizer updates and all four preregistered held-out evaluations; its near-flat approximately 12 dB curve is retained without a visual-quality claim.

Fresh n1.1m completed exactly 20,000 optimizer updates and all four preregistered held-out evaluations. Final EMA clean, edge and temporal-change PSNR were 27.7460, 20.9956 and 21.2332 dB; visual acceptance remains pending.
The same healthy pipeline advanced to fresh n3.7m training after completing the first two arms; no restart or cross-experiment checkpoint reuse occurred.
